assessments.identity: Zn2SiO4 mineral; IMA G1830 (not a numbered approval), distinct from natural mixed slag/ore and synthetic experimental feed. No inherited criticality.

experiments.claim: Qualified lichen-associated alteration within mixed slag, not exclusive causal bioleaching proof.
experiments.organism: Stereocaulon exutum, morphology/color reactions only; currentNCBITaxon373707 maps species name, not voucher or associated microbiome.
experiments.conditions: EasternOkayama field collections21April2011–28September2013; sample dates not exposure duration. No controlled incubation or matched sterile field arm.
experiments.evidence: §§2.1–2.3; §§3.1–3.2/Figures2,4–5; §4.1 explicitly cannot distinguish lichen from other microbes or clarify acid pathway. No displayed XRD patterns despite reported XRD identification.
experiments.limits: Etch pits, hypha penetration and elemental redistribution support association. Bulk thallus/substrate correlations are not willemite extraction yields. No isolated product. Sampling§2.2 counts18lichens12slags7tailings4rocks differ from analyzed XRF counts7slags8tailings7rocks; not silently harmonized.

experiments.evidence: §§2.1–2.2/Table1/Figure1/Eq1;§3.1.1/Figures2–3.79.78% at16min is volume-corrected aqueousZn/feedZn, not product recovery.
experiments.limits: Table1Zn48.7–49.5%/SiO234.8–36.5% differs from formula-based ideal58.7/27.0%; EDS also inconsistent with perfect stoichiometry. XRD-only purity assertion is qualified. Fitted diffusion model not unique microscopic proof; no explicit independent replicates. ConcentrateTable3/Figures16–17 has separate conditions/quartz residue; not pooled.
